row.name: JBG SMITH Properties Common Shares

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=3 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.32 tightness=0.83 base_volume_vs_leg=0.7 base_volume_vs_avg=0.64
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 6.1% vs its 20-SMA, 12.5% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The single most decisive flaw is the recorded RE FAIL: the burst bar's range of 6.5% is only 0.77x the largest of the prior five bars, meaning today's expansion is not the widest recent bar and the range-expansion criterion fails outright. The chart confirms this — the base region (Nov 10–12) is tight and orderly with low volume, and the signal bar closes near its high with strong volume, but several bars in the prior leg and base area are visibly comparable in width to the burst bar. Everything else — linearity, trend youth, consolidation quality, H, and VOL — is solid.
claude.key_risk: The burst bar is not a true range expansion relative to recent sessions, so follow-through buying may be limited if the move stalls at the prior resistance zone near $12.70–$13.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the base high of $12.72 by more than 1% or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior close of $11.99.
